measurement_unit: unique canonical ASCII first DNS label
canonicalizer: ml.dga.domain_label; lowercase first label of a valid observed FQDN; no suffix-only, IDNA repair, live lookup, or payload decryption

existing_source_manifests.scope: Seven smaller family/reference files; all previously inspected; per-file SHA256 and byte counts are in this manifest
50 DGA variant files plus one 100000-domain legitimate reference; all previously assigned to development; per-file SHA256 and byte counts are in this manifest
Both labelled benign captures already used; per-capture SHA256 is in this catalog; mixed captures lack per-query DGA truth
Feature-design and regression exposure only; never independent public DGA evaluation

feature_design_and_runtime_regression: UMUDGA expanded family and legitimate references
legacy_nb_training: legit first six full-FQDN hash buckets
exposure_inventory.current_candidate_threshold_tuning: expanded UMUDGA validation families and benign first-label hash buckets 6-7; fixed threshold grid selected 0.9

training.status: used for current candidate fitting; retained as training for any next development experiment

validation_tuning.status: previously used for model selection and threshold choice; development only

inspected_development_comparison.status: formerly called test; inspected over multiple iterations and in diagnosis; not reserved

inspected_dns_reference.status: already inspected; development DNS reference, not reserved

reserved_evaluation_preregistration.required_positive: exactly 1000 distinct first labels from each of three documented DGA algorithms absent from all 50 UMUDGA development variants and their known aliases/derivatives; select by ascending SHA256 of protocol_id + ':' + label after exclusions
reserved_evaluation_preregistration.required_domain_benign: exactly 600 distinct first labels from each of five documented benign strata: short, machine-generated legitimate, CDN/cloud-style, common popular, and long; source role must be supported by provenance, not inferred from detector output; select by ascending SHA256 of protocol_id + ':' + stratum + ':' + label after exclusions
reserved_evaluation_preregistration.benign_stratum_assignment: apply source-documented categories in precedence common popular, machine-generated legitimate, CDN/cloud-style; assign remaining documented benign labels to short (<12 characters) or long (>=12 characters); one label belongs to one stratum only
reserved_evaluation_preregistration.required_dns_benign: at least 2500 distinct first labels from a separately sourced benign DNS capture or query log; include every eligible label after exclusions, not a performance-based subset
reserved_evaluation_preregistration.exclusions: remove identical scored first labels across all development data, across reserved positive/benign/DNS classes, and within conflicting reserved labels; never resplit individual rows of the same DGA family/algorithm into development and reserved sets
reserved_evaluation_preregistration.evaluation_once: record all raw source identifiers, versions, licence, retrieval date, file bytes, SHA256, algorithm/stratum labels and post-exclusion counts in a materialization manifest before any candidate scores are computed; one final scoring pass; a failed candidate stays disabled; a subsequent tuned candidate needs a new independent reserved set

threshold_policy: fit and select one threshold using training and development validation only, with the existing predeclared grid [0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.85,0.9,0.95,0.975,0.99]; record candidate artifact SHA256 and selected threshold before reserved scoring; no reserved-threshold search

promotion_gates.metric_denominator: domain recall=TP/(TP+FN), precision=TP/(TP+FP), domain FPR=FP/(FP+TN) on the frozen balanced 3000-positive/3000-negative domain set; separate DNS FPR=FP/(FP+TN) on its distinct benign labels
promotion_gates.rule: all four gates must pass on the single frozen reserved evaluation; no threshold search, feature tuning, sample replacement, or gate adjustment after seeing it

tuning_exclusion: The future materialized reserved DGA-algorithm domain set, its five-stratum legitimate-domain set, and its separate benign-DNS set must not be inspected or scored during training, validation, or threshold tuning. Previously inspected UMUDGA comparison and benign-benign_2 are development diagnostics only.
